name: Claimable Value
summary: Describes whether a guest interaction has produced value that may be preserved by a durable identity.

values.name: None
values.summary: No durable or claim-worthy value has been identified.

values.name: Detected
values.summary: A value signal has been detected and account creation may be recommended.

values.name: Claimable
values.summary: Conversation or produced artifacts are ready to be claimed.

values.name: Claiming
values.summary: An atomic claim operation is in progress.

values.name: Claimed
values.summary: The value is owned by a durable identity.

values.name: Expired
values.summary: The value can no longer be claimed.
